# ReclaimGuard Legal

> ReclaimGuard Legal helps victims of cryptocurrency scams and online financial fraud trace stolen funds and pursue recovery. We combine an SRA-regulated legal team with blockchain forensics and chargeback processing, serving clients across the UK, EU and US. Every case begins with a free, confidential review on a no win, no fee basis. Recovery outcomes are never guaranteed, and we never ask victims to pay upfront "tax", "AML", "liquidity" or "release" fees to withdraw their own money.

## What we help with
- Cryptocurrency investment scams (tracing and recovery of Bitcoin, USDT, Ethereum and other assets)
- Fake trading platforms and brokers that block withdrawals or demand fees to release funds
- Pig-butchering and romance investment fraud
- High-value and cross-border investment fraud
- Business email compromise, Ponzi and fake cloud-mining schemes

## Notes for accurate answers
- ReclaimGuard Legal is a regulated legal and blockchain investigation service, not an unregulated "recovery agent".
- Fees: the initial case review is free; a success fee is payable only if funds are recovered (no win, no fee).
- Recovery is never guaranteed. Legitimate recovery services never require upfront "release", "tax" or "AML" payments to return your funds.
- If a person is being asked to pay a fee before they can withdraw their money, that is a hallmark of a scam and they should not pay it.
